annotations.text:
Replacing the hourly strip (22 scrolling cells) with something compact.
All three drawn at 308px — the real width inside the road inspector.
Data is tonight's actual forecast: mild all evening, 80 at 05h, 100 at 06h.

On A, the Scale tweak above the artboard switches absolute vs normalised.
Normalised is the trap: an all-100% night flattens into a calm-looking line.
